# Q1 – Does startup supply in a business function lead firm adoption in that function? (internal)

**Question.** Does startup supply in a business function run ahead of firm adoption of AI in that function?

**Method / linkage.** Function crosswalk (dataset:66); supply per function and batch year; Spearman across functions.

**n.** EU 7 comparable functions (synthetic fixture).

**Key finding.** Startup supply and firm adoption converge on the same functions, with a short lead (synthetic).

**Caveats.** Very small n.
